scene: Clutching your new tin robot, you exit onto the busy promenade.
picture: A wide side-scrolling view of a bustling seaside transit pier. On the far left, a yellow water taxi bobs beside a dock. In the centre, the bearded elderly player in his orange cardigan holds a tin robot. Up high right rests an inclined funicular car. On the far right stands a red-canopied rickshaw.
shown: a striped yellow water taxi moored at the pier on the far left
a glass-walled funicular car parked on steep tracks up high right
a red canopy rickshaw and driver waiting curbside on the far right
